title: [HLS] Large ID3-data not supported by parser
body:
ID3 data can be divided into multiple PES packets, according to spec. ExoPlayer's Id3Parser doesn't seem to support this case, and fails at ID3 tags longer than 65535 (-header) bytes. See stacktrace below. Here is an example stream that breaks the parser, http://www.pvv.org/~perchrh/large_id3_packet_hls/playlist.m3u8 The relevant piece of HLS documentation seems to be this (section 2.4), https://developer.apple.com/library/ios/documentation/AudioVideo/Conceptual/HTTP_Live_Streaming_Metadata_Spec/2/2.html "If an ID3 tag is longer than 65535 bytes, it must have more than one PES header. The second and following PES headers must have data_alignment set to 0, and should have the PTS_DTS_flags set to ‘00’ (and hence no PTS)."
